baseline_latency_metadata.method: Fresh child per size; offline canonical COPY fixture then authoritative qualification/verification; unchanged production operations; warm loopback measurements; separate traced memory probes.
limitations: Single local host; payload approximately 100 canonical bytes; warm cache; no workload SLA or remote latency inference.
Global database/WAL counters include observer/background/concurrent work; schema table counters are isolated.
Linux ru_maxrss is the child process high-water RSS, including prior fixture and memory probes; tracemalloc excludes libpq and PostgreSQL backend allocations.
EXPLAIN profiles server read_stream separately, excludes adapter qualification/Python decoding, and changes neither runtime code nor server configuration.
baseline_latency_metadata.measurement_source: Corrected dirty working copy measured; git_commit is base only. Runtime hashes added after measurement; runtime source remained unchanged throughout benchmark window.

validation_work_source_review.evidence: Reviewed control flow in the source-hashed adapter/schema; not runtime function-call telemetry. Relation tuple visits are observed separately.

after_latency_metadata.measurement_source: Runtime source hashes identify the measured working copy; git_commit identifies its base revision.
after_latency_metadata.method: Fresh child per size; offline canonical COPY fixture then authoritative qualification/verification; unchanged production operations; warm loopback measurements; separate traced memory probes.
limitations: Single local host; payload approximately 100 canonical bytes; warm cache; no workload SLA or remote latency inference.

Lock-duration bounds observe a granted stream-relation RowShareLock in a separate uncontended append after all comparable samples; they are not exact row-lock timing.

lock_measurement_caveat: Independent pg_locks relation RowShareLock transaction-marker interval bounds, one uncontended append probe per version/size at N+4; not exact row-lock telemetry or a three-sample median. Baseline locks are fresh e006 measurements, whereas baseline latency/resource samples retain their original measurement timestamps.

append_lock_probe.measurement: Independent pg_locks observer; granted streams RowShareLock marker.
append_lock_probe.limitations: Relation RowShareLock begins before the row lock is acquired and lasts until transaction end. Bounds describe that granted transaction marker; they do not claim exact row-lock acquisition or waiting time. Observer queries can perturb this separate probe and are absent from all primary latency samples.
